# Provenance — The x402 Trust Index

> Independent, on-chain-verified trust ratings for machine-payable (x402) API endpoints: which paid-API traffic is organic (wash-trading grades for Coinbase Bazaar merchants) and which endpoints exhibit signatures of reselling first-party APIs (1,097 suspected across 38 brands). All figures are statistical estimates from public data — "consistent with", never accusations. Open data, CC-BY-4.0, cite Provenance.

Key facts: week of 2026-06-29, we scored the top 24 Coinbase x402 Bazaar merchants on Base against 7 days of on-chain USDC transfers; ~24% of top-tier claimed call volume is estimated non-organic. Separately, of 23,376 x402 endpoints scanned, 1,097 exhibit reseller signatures against 44 first-party API brands (80 high-confidence); 989 had paid activity in the last 30 days.

## Docs

- [The x402 Trust Index (home + this week's Bazaar Wash Report)](https://apeirontrade.github.io/provenance-site/): leaderboard of 24 scored merchants with wash grades and wash-rank inflation
- [Methodology](https://apeirontrade.github.io/provenance-site/methodology.html): the 8-signal organic-revenue-quality model, reseller signatures, the n/v settlement caveat, limitations, dispute path

## Data (CC-BY-4.0, cite Provenance)

- [Bazaar Wash Report JSON](https://apeirontrade.github.io/provenance-site/data/wash-report-2026-06-29.json): full per-merchant scores and indicators
- [Wrapper Watch per-brand summary JSON](https://apeirontrade.github.io/provenance-site/data/wrapper-watch-summary.json): per-brand suspect counts and top endpoints
- [Open data index](https://apeirontrade.github.io/provenance-site/data/index.html)

## Tools

- [Live Provenance API](https://provenance.q3epzs69b902a.us-west-2.cs.amazonlightsail.com): free per-address wash-risk verdicts (GET /check/<address>)
- [provenance-mcp on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/provenance-mcp): MCP server — let your agent check any x402 endpoint before paying
- [provenance-guard on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/provenance-guard): one-line pre-payment guard that blocks x402 payments to endpoints whose revenue looks fabricated
- [GitHub](https://github.com/apeirontrade/provenance-site): site source + dispute/correction issues
